name: Flohmarkt am GLOBUS Jena-Isserstedt

rhythm.en: About once a month, on a Saturday

facts: on the GLOBUS car park at the B7 towards Weimar, signposted nearby
mostly second-hand goods, with a few pitches for new goods by arrangement
no registration and no reservation — sellers just turn up
sellers may park the car at their stall
pitches handed out from 06:00, selling 08:00 to 16:00
stall 9 EUR a metre for second-hand goods, 10 EUR for new
notes: Fourteen dates listed for 2026; the last is 12 December and 2027 is not published yet. Visitor entry is not stated (open car park), so left null. Isserstedt is a district of Jena and carries its own postal code, 07751. Organiser's Impressum splits east and west: the eastern markets are Hans Thomas Lampert, Spechsart 23, 06618 Naumburg, naumburg@lampert-maerkte.de. Coordinates from Nominatim for Weimarische Straße 3.

description.de: Etwa einmal im Monat samstags auf dem GLOBUS-Parkplatz an der B7 Richtung Weimar. Überwiegend Gebrauchtes, ein paar Plätze für Neuware nach Absprache. Keine Anmeldung: Plätze werden ab 6 Uhr vergeben, verkauft wird von 8 bis 16 Uhr, das Auto bleibt am Stand.
description.en: About once a month on a Saturday on the GLOBUS car park by the B7 towards Weimar. Mostly second-hand, with a few pitches for new goods by arrangement. No registration: pitches go from 6, selling runs 8 to 4, and the car stays at the stall.
